# Block Source Syntax

Every lab's block programs are written in **scratchblocks** text - the same
markup the Scratch Wiki uses. One `.txt` file per program drives two outputs:

- the block diagram rendered on the lab page (`<pre class="blocks">`)
- the downloadable `.sb3` program, compiled by `scripts/make_sb3.py`

Because both come from the same file, the picture a student sees and the
project they open can never disagree.

## Writing rules

1. **One block per line.** Leading whitespace is ignored by the compiler, but
   indent the body of a C-block anyway so the source stays readable.
2. **C-blocks close with `end`.** `repeat`, `forever`, `if`, `if/else`, and
   `repeat until` all need a matching `end`. `else` sits on its own line.
3. **Blank lines separate scripts.** Two scripts in one file become two
   separate stacks in the project.
4. **Operand brackets carry meaning**, exactly as in Scratch:
   - `(100)` - a number or a reporter slot
   - `[text]` - a text slot
   - `[choice v]` - a dropdown
   - `[#ff8800]` - a colour
   - `<...>` - a boolean slot
5. **Spacing disambiguates `<` and `>`.** `<(x) > (50)>` is a
   greater-than inside a boolean: the operator has spaces around it, the
   brackets do not. Write comparisons that way and nesting resolves correctly.
6. **Anything in round brackets that is not a number, a known reporter, or a
   custom-block parameter becomes a variable**, and the compiler creates that
   variable in the project automatically. `set [angle v] to (90)` followed by
   `turn cw (angle) degrees` is all you need - there is no declaration step.
7. **Comments** start with `//` and run to the end of the line.
8. **Escape angle brackets in `index.md`.** Inside `<pre class="blocks">`,
   write `&lt;` and `&gt;` so the browser's HTML parser does not swallow a
   boolean. The `.txt` file itself uses plain `<` and `>`;
   `scripts/check_lab.py --fix` applies the escaping when it syncs the page.
9. **An unrecognized line is an error, not a guess.** `make_sb3.py` fails the
   build and names the closest known block. If a lab needs a block that is not
   in the table below, add it to the `BLOCKS` table in `make_sb3.py` and rerun
   `gen_syntax_ref.py`.

## Custom blocks

```
define star (size) (points)
repeat (points)
  move (size) steps
  turn cw (144) degrees
end

when green flag clicked
star (100) (5)
```

`define` must appear in the same file as the calls to it. Round parameters
become "number or text" inputs (`%s`); angle-bracket parameters become boolean
inputs (`%b`). Inside the definition body a parameter name in round brackets
compiles to an argument reporter rather than a variable.

## Supported blocks

In a signature, `%` stands for any operand.


### Events

| Write this | Opcode | Shape |
|------------|--------|-------|
| `broadcast %` | `event_broadcast` | stack |
| `when % key pressed` | `event_whenkeypressed` | hat |
| `when green flag clicked`<br>also: `when @greenflag clicked`, `when flag clicked`, `when gf clicked` | `event_whenflagclicked` | hat |
| `when i receive %` | `event_whenbroadcastreceived` | hat |
| `when this sprite clicked` | `event_whenthisspriteclicked` | hat |

### Motion

| Write this | Opcode | Shape |
|------------|--------|-------|
| `change x by %` | `motion_changexby` | stack |
| `change y by %` | `motion_changeyby` | stack |
| `direction` | `motion_direction` | reporter |
| `glide % secs to x: % y: %` | `motion_glidesecstoxy` | stack |
| `go to x: % y: %` | `motion_gotoxy` | stack |
| `if on edge, bounce` | `motion_ifonedgebounce` | stack |
| `move % steps` | `motion_movesteps` | stack |
| `point in direction %` | `motion_pointindirection` | stack |
| `set x to %` | `motion_setx` | stack |
| `set y to %` | `motion_sety` | stack |
| `turn ccw % degrees`<br>also: `turn @turnleft % degrees`, `turn left % degrees`, `turn ↺ % degrees` | `motion_turnleft` | stack |
| `turn cw % degrees`<br>also: `turn @turnright % degrees`, `turn right % degrees`, `turn ↻ % degrees` | `motion_turnright` | stack |
| `x position` | `motion_xposition` | reporter |
| `y position` | `motion_yposition` | reporter |

### Pen

| Write this | Opcode | Shape |
|------------|--------|-------|
| `change pen % by %` | `pen_changePenColorParamBy` | stack |
| `change pen size by %` | `pen_changePenSizeBy` | stack |
| `erase all`<br>also: `clear` | `pen_clear` | stack |
| `pen down` | `pen_penDown` | stack |
| `pen up` | `pen_penUp` | stack |
| `set pen % to %` | `pen_setPenColorParamTo` | stack |
| `set pen color to %` | `pen_setPenColorToColor` | stack |
| `set pen size to %` | `pen_setPenSizeTo` | stack |
| `stamp` | `pen_stamp` | stack |

Any pen block adds `"extensions": ["pen"]` to the generated project, so a student opening the `.sb3` finds the Pen category already loaded.

### Control

| Write this | Opcode | Shape |
|------------|--------|-------|
| `forever` | `control_forever` | cap, needs `end` |
| `if % then` | `control_if` | stack, needs `end` |
| `if % then else`<br>also: `if % then, else` | `control_if_else` | stack, needs `end` |
| `repeat %` | `control_repeat` | stack, needs `end` |
| `repeat until %` | `control_repeat_until` | stack, needs `end` |
| `stop %` | `control_stop` | cap |
| `wait % seconds`<br>also: `wait % secs` | `control_wait` | stack |
| `wait until %` | `control_wait_until` | stack |

`if % then else` is the compiler's internal name for the two-branch form; you never type it. Write `if <...> then`, put `else` on its own line, and close with `end` - the compiler promotes the block for you.

| `% + %` | `operator_add` | reporter |
| `% - %` | `operator_subtract` | reporter |
| `% / %` | `operator_divide` | reporter |
| `% < %` | `operator_lt` | boolean |
| `% = %` | `operator_equals` | boolean |
| `% > %` | `operator_gt` | boolean |
| `% and %` | `operator_and` | boolean |
| `% mod %` | `operator_mod` | reporter |
| `% or %` | `operator_or` | boolean |
| `join % %` | `operator_join` | reporter |
| `not %` | `operator_not` | boolean |
| `pick random % to %` | `operator_random` | reporter |
| `round %` | `operator_round` | reporter |
